name: Shoyo Hinataka
bio: Smallest giant. Boom-jump clears the tape.

name: Tobio Kageyamo
bio: King of the court. Tosses arrive before blockers move.

name: Daichi Sawado
bio: Captain wall. Holds the receive line together.

name: Asahi Azah
bio: Ace cannon. When he fires, the gym shakes.

name: Yu Nishinoyo
bio: Rolling thunder. Balls that should die, live.

name: Kei Tsukishimo
bio: Reads setters like open books. Power is modest; timing is not.

name: Hisashi Kinoshito
bio: Pin jump-serve specialist off the bench.

name: Kazuhito Narito
bio: Utility middle. Does the dirty work.

name: Kenma Kozumo
bio: Brain first. Never wastes a set — or energy.

name: Tetsuro Kuroh
bio: Funnel block captain. Feeds diggers on purpose.

name: Morisuke Yakuh
bio: Cat libero. Endless rallies start here.

name: Taketora Yamamotoh
bio: Hot-blooded wing. Hair stands when he fires.

name: Shoyo Fukunagah
bio: Technical wing. Tips, tools, and grit.

name: Hajime Iwaizumo
bio: Rock ace. No holes — and no patience for drama.

name: Shinji Watarih
bio: Quiet libero. Cleans Oikawo serves in practice.

name: Kentaro Kyotanih
bio: Mad dog opposite. Raw power, raw fuse.

name: Satori Tendoh
bio: Guess monster. High variance, higher chaos.

name: Reon Ohirah
bio: Two-way wing. Steady beside the ace.

name: Kenjiro Shirabuh
bio: Feeds the ace. Medical student composure.

name: Eita Semih
bio: Backup setter with a jump serve.

name: Tsutomu Goshikih
bio: Aspiring ace. Hungry for the big sets.

name: Atsumu Miyah
bio: Twin setter. Jump and float serves both elite.

name: Osamu Miyah
bio: Twin opposite. Sets, spikes, and cooks.

name: Kotaro Bokutoh
bio: Emotive ace. Hot streak = unstoppable; cold = chaos.

name: Keiji Akaasho
bio: Manages the owl fire. Soft voice, hard IQ.

name: Tatsuki Washioh
bio: Stern middle. Wall with a scowl.

name: Takanobu Aono
bio: Iron wall. The net is his kingdom.

name: Korai Hoshiumo
bio: Little giant. Sky attack clears all.

name: Wakatsu Kiryuh
bio: Hits bad sets like good ones.

name: Kiyoomi Sakuso
bio: Late wrist magic. Changes direction mid-air.
